mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Gate Colossus: "Affinity for Gates. This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or
# less. Whenever a Gate you control enters, you may put this card from your graveyard on top of your
# library."
# [0]: Affinity for Gates (CR 702.41a) as Claws Out's mapped affinity: a generic reduction of
# QBin(MUL, 1, QCount(Gates you control)) on this spell (Circuitous Route's SUBTYPE_EQ Gate).
# [1]: Juggernaut's mapped "This creature can't be blocked by Walls." with the blockers "creatures with
# power 2 or less" (Vanquish the Weak's POWER_LE).
# [2]: the landfall event (Scute Swarm) over Gates you control; effect: an optional move of this card
# from your graveyard (Silversmote Ghoul's `cards`) to the top of your library (Teferi, Timeless
# Voyager's TOP). The effect moves its own card out of the graveyard, so the ability works only there
# (CR 113.6m, binding.functions_from_graveyard).
affinity = CostModifier(
    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    controller_ref=ControllerRef.YOU,
    delta=CostDeltaReduceGeneric(
        amount=QBin(
            op=QBinOp.MUL,
            left=QConst(value=1),
            right=QCount(
                selector=Selector(
                    count=QUnbounded(),
                    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Gate'),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
evasion = StaticAbility(
    effect=A(Verb.PREVENT_EFFECT, {
        'condition': FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        'event': DeclareBlockersEvent(
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.POWER_LE, count=QConst(value=2)),
                ),
            ),
            blocked=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        ),
    }),
)
gate_enters = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Gate'),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=OptionalEffect(
        inner=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
            ),
            'destination': Zone(
                kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY,
                controller=ControllerRef.YOU,
                position=ZonePosition.TOP,
            ),
        }),
    ),
)
abilities = [affinity, evasion, gate_enters, *compiled]
